title: The Limits of Behavioral Early Warning for Copy-Trading Blow-Ups: A Pre-Registered, Full-Universe On-Chain Study (Hyperliquid)
abstract: arXiv:2611.27988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A common, rarely-tested assumption behind copy-trading risk controls is that "behavioral monitoring catches blow-ups": that a master trader's conduct drifts before the equity damage that wipes out followers. We test this on real on-chain money over the full public Hyperliquid leaderboard: 37,895 addresses, filtered to 10,395 "master-worth-copying" accounts, yielding 2,621 genuine loss-driven idiosyncratic blow-ups across 48 independent crash-days. On a model-free panel of 2,477 blow-up masters, behavioral drift leads equity for only 9% (216 masters); 69% blow up with no gradual behavioral signal at all, and the overall median lead is negative (-8 days): when conduct moves, it typically lags the equity rather than leading it. translated_title: 跟单交易爆仓行为学预警的局限性：一项预注册的全量链上研究（Hyperliquid）
translated_abstract: 跟单交易风险控制背后一个常见但很少被检验的假设是“行为监控能够捕捉爆仓”，即带单交易员的行为会在损毁跟单者权益之前发生漂移。我们在Hyperliquid完整公开排行榜的真实链上资金上检验了这一假设：37,895个地址，筛选出10,395个“值得跟单”的带单账户，在48个独立的崩盘日中产生了2,621次真实的损失驱动型特异性爆仓。在一个由2,477个爆仓带单者构成的免模型面板中，行为漂移仅在9%（216个带单者）的案例中领先于权益变化；69%的爆仓完全没有任何渐进的行为信号，且总体中位领先期为负（-8天）：当行为发生变化时，它通常是滞后于权益而非领先。一个专门构建的三轴混合SPRT（序贯概率比检验）检测器，经过预注册并在不相交的调优集上冻结其工作点、仅对密封测试集读取一次，证实了而非突破这一边界……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对Hyperliquid全平台37,895个地址的预注册链上实证分析发现，带单交易员的行为漂移仅在9%的爆仓事件中领先于权益损失，69%的爆仓完全没有渐进行为信号，表明“行为监控能预警跟单爆仓”这一常见假设存在根本性局限。
en_tdlr: Through a pre-registered full-universe on-chain study of 37,895 Hyperliquid addresses, this paper shows that behavioral drift precedes equity damage in only 9% of copy-trading blow-ups (with 69% showing no gradual behavioral signal at all), demonstrating the fundamental limits of behavioral early warning for copy-trading risk control.
